rationale: The sunglasses were lost to a wild macaque while the customer was wearing them, which the claims manual (section 7, wild animals) treats as accidental loss rather than theft, so no police report is needed. The loss falls under Baggage and Personal Effects (wording section 5); the guide's letter and the replacement receipt are on file, and the payout is the $240 claimed, below the First per-item limit of $500, with a $0 deductible on First (wording sections 1 and 10; manual sections 5 to 7).
